built_for: #change Locate screen — current state (extent / condition / change)
licence: CC BY 4.0 upstream (GMW v4.1.12 1996→2025 extent differencing; GMW 2025 extent stock; Dynamic World built modal). Non-commercial / research P2.
resolution_plain: Extent is GMW 2025 stock (~30 m native, ~100 m after simplify). Loss/gain are GMW v4.1.12 1996→2025 extent differencing (~30 m native, ~100 m after simplify) — finer than the old Goldberg coastal sample. Built sample remains generalised (~200 m). Overlays fade past about zoom 11.5.

state_gaps.plain: GMW 2025 mangrove extent ships as a coastal stock layer on Locate (open CC BY). Annual time slider remains a data need.
No mangrove condition, health, canopy, or degradation score ships on this console. Note 3b: degradation not mapped (no canopy layer cleared for public).

GMW 1996→2025 loss (and optional gain) from annual extent differencing, plus a built-up proxy. Not an annual time slider or multi-epoch urban expansion series. Goldberg 2000–2016 loss-driver polygons are demoted (not on Locate).

layers.title: Mangrove extent 2025 (stock)
layers.resolution_plain: GMW v4.1.12 2025 extent, coastal four-province clip, simplified for Locate (~100 m display). Living stock — not a condition score.
layers.note: Global Mangrove Watch annual extent 2025 (CC BY 4.0). Clipped to L20 coastal provinces; MMU 0.5 ha. Fills the Locate extent / stock facet.

layers.title: Mangrove loss 1996–2025 (GMW)
layers.resolution_plain: GMW v4.1.12 extent differencing (1996 minus 2025), coastal clip, MMU 0.5 ha, ~100 m simplify. Replaces the coarser Goldberg loss-driver stub.
layers.note: Loss = mangrove in GMW 1996 extent and absent in 2025. Same product family as the 2025 stock layer (CC BY 4.0). Not a driver map.

layers.title: Mangrove gain 1996–2025 (GMW)
layers.resolution_plain: GMW v4.1.12 extent differencing (2025 minus 1996), coastal clip, MMU 0.5 ha, ~100 m simplify. Optional — default off on Locate.
layers.note: Gain = mangrove in GMW 2025 extent and absent in 1996. Includes recovery and mapping refinement; treat as context, not a restoration score.

layers.title: Built-up / urban change
layers.resolution_plain: Dynamic World built modal, coastal sample, simplified for the public stub (~200 m display). Pressure context only.
layers.note: Open coastal sample of Dynamic World modal built (class 6). GHS-BUILT multi-epoch remains a data need.

GMW annual time slider (all epochs) on Locate — currently single-interval 1996→2025
Goldberg ORNL DAAC loss-driver attribution (demoted; rebuild via build_change_stubs.py if needed)
